test_dtype_of_expressions: test that pl.dtype_of returns equivalent expressions for map_batches and replace_strict operations
test_dtype_classification: test that dtype expressions correctly match numeric, integer, float, decimal, categorical, enum, nested, list, array, struct, and temporal selectors
test_default_value: test that dtype expressions produce correct default values for integer, float, string, decimal, temporal, struct, array, list, categorical, enum, null, and object types
test_array_dimensions: test that dtype expressions return correct width and shape for Array types with single and multi-dimensional widths
test_struct_field_access: test that dtype expressions access struct fields by index and name and return correct inner dtypes
test_dtype_expr_display: test that dtype expressions produce correct display strings for all supported Polars data types
test_dtype_expr_wrap_in_container: test that dtype expressions wrap dtypes in List or Array containers correctly
